claim: For every field \(k\) of positive characteristic \(p\) and integer \(m\ge2\), let \(A_m=k[x,y]/(x^2,y^m)\) and let \(G_m\) be its automorphism group scheme. Its dimension is \(3m-2\) if \(p>2\) and \(p\nmid m\); \(3m-1\) if \(p>2\) and \(p\mid m\); \(3m+\lfloor m/2\rfloor-2\) if \(p=2\) and \(m\) is odd; and \(7m/2-1\) if \(p=2\) and \(m\) is even. The tangent-space dimension is respectively \(3m-2,3m,4m-2,4m\), so \(G_m\) is smooth exactly when \(p>2\) and \(p\nmid m\), with tangent excess \(1,\lceil m/2\rceil, m/2+1\) in the three nonsmooth cases.

integrity.proof_basis: Coefficient parameterization of geometric automorphisms and direct derivation calculation.
integrity.scope: Theorem for the stated two-generator monomial algebra, for all integers m at least two, over every field.

scientific_limitations: The result gives scheme dimension, tangent dimension, and smoothness, but not a full coordinate-ring presentation or group law in every characteristic.
The comparison search is not an exhaustive proof of global novelty.
title: Characteristic-dependent automorphism schemes of \(k[x,y]/(x^2,y^m)\)
